description: A full-length dark teal noble deel and layered wrap coat with broad bronze-gold floral and interlaced woven borders, long sleeves and ornamented cuffs. A matching dark patterned inner robe shows at the overlapping front and lower hem, with a pale inner collar. A wide dark sash and belt carry round engraved gold-toned discs and a long tassel. Dark patterned trousers and plain dark leather knee-high boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
